decisions.reason: As a yogurt variant close to the core range, it is still relatively cheap to carry, so despite the lack of recent visible signals its option value is not yet exhausted.
Because it was positioned as a flagship cheese within the firm's strategic core, management would give it more time before abandoning it absent clear failure evidence.
After several years with no further positive signal, this fairly standard semi-hard cheese appears to offer little remaining learning or upside relative to the resources tied up in keeping it.
A multi-variant spicy cheese line uses more assortment and commercial attention, and with uncertainty now largely resolved the prudent choice is to prune it and reallocate resources.
